source_reply_requirements: Preserve original received message bytes without normalization and record SHA-256.
Record source/sender, original Message-ID, original Date header and actual received/capture timestamp with provenance; do not invent missing headers or independent timestamp assurance.
Pin documentary pointers by exact URL, retrieved bytes SHA-256, timestamp and locators; a URL alone does not establish a parameter.
For every affected parameter distinguish EXPLICIT_ANSWER, DOCUMENTARY_POINTER, PARTIAL_ANSWER or UNRESOLVED; record literal excerpt separately from analyst interpretation.
Record dataset/export/version applicability, units, qualification and unresolved dependencies.
Keep parameter value null unless the received evidence establishes that parameter for the relevant export; partial answers retain unresolved components and do not become defaults.
Version the evidence-to-parameter mapping append-only and preserve superseded evidence.
A reply does not itself freeze an instrument, assign reference labels, generate predictions or authorize gate/RB1–RB5 execution.
